question: Which auspicious symbol is counted among the gods' eight auspicious things?
premises: It is one of all eight auspicious things.
inference: Nandyāvarta is an auspicious symbol of the gods.
uncertainties: sarveṣāmaṣṭamaṅgalam is a fused genitive-nominative phrase.
plain_english: Nandyāvarta is an auspicious symbol of all the gods.
